name: stable-completion-controller-v1

scope.primary_change: replace the unvalidated racing-line override with an explicit controller that reproduces the completion-proven 52976fe runtime

reference.interpretation: This is deterministic consumed-development evidence and a source-lineage target, not fresh generalization evidence or a SOTA result.

hypothesis.failure: The active runtime accumulated broad grayscale hazard, edge, obstacle, and recovery heuristics that fire on ordinary road geometry; model.pt is bypassed, so those unvalidated heuristics are the effective policy.
hypothesis.repair: Make the smaller completion-proven camera controller an explicit current runtime class while preserving all DrQ, explicit baseline-export, and HAIC policy paths.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Recover deterministic completion on the consumed diagnostic cell and remove the overbroad hazard state machine from the bare-checkpoint action path without changing weights or official environment code.

unit: The stable class matches the 52976fe controller's deterministic action sequence on representative straight, curve, obstacle, invalid-input, and reset cases.
Bare model.pt explicitly routes to the stable class while DrQ and explicit exports retain their existing paths.
All existing controller, inference, local simulator, contract, and submission tests pass.

consumed_development_smoke.minimum_result: finished=true with zero damage and zero collisions
consumed_development_smoke.interpretation: diagnostic only; no SOTA, unseen-track, or submission claim

abort: The stable implementation diverges from the frozen 52976fe reference action contract.
Any DrQ, explicit baseline-export, HAIC, official environment, frozen experiment, or reserved seed changes.
Relevant tests regress or the single consumed-development smoke does not finish cleanly.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md, and report.pdf are absent.
No fresh evaluation, generalization claim, submission, or SOTA promotion is authorized until those sources are restored and audited.
